title: Expert Candidate Ranking Schema
description: Schema for batch candidate ranking groups evaluated against a specific job description.

candidate_ids.description: Ordered or unordered list of candidate resume IDs included in the ranking group.

expert_rank.description: Mapping from resume_id to rank position (1 = top candidate, 2 = second, etc.). Tied ranks are allowed.

group_id.description: Unique identifier for this ranking cohort.

evaluator_id.description: Anonymized identifier for the human evaluator.

adjudicated.description: Whether this record is a post-disagreement consensus/adjudicated cohort ranking.
